description: Next vía of a deity among the occurrences of its vía events, and its countdown (BR-CAL-13), relative to today's device date. Occurrence dates are test inputs standing for what the calendar returns; the vectors never assert a lunar-to-solar conversion (covered by calendar event-placement.json).

inputs.occurrences: list of the deity's vía occurrences as the festival calendar gives them: event name, solar date, calendar display order (BR-CAL-12); any order

output.next_via: null when no occurrence is on or after today; else event, solar_date, days (solar_date minus today), label today | tomorrow | days_left (copy: Hôm nay / Ngày mai / Còn n ngày)
